proof_roadmap: Flat base change for Ext (proof lines 16723-16724).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for a flat ring map, Hom out of a finitely presented module and, more generally, Ext groups in low degrees out of a pseudo-coherent module commute with base change, and that for a finite module over a Noetherian ring this holds in all degrees. The proof computes the Ext groups after base change as Ext groups over the source against the base changed second argument, using the flat base change result for Ext, and then applies the earlier statement expressing Ext out of a pseudo-coherent module as base change of the original Ext groups. The Noetherian case follows from the identification of finite modules with pseudo-coherent ones.
